RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the March 8, 2002/Phalguna 17, 1923 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean
Development; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel; Youth Affairs and
Sports)
Total number of questions—155

Salinity increase in Gujarat
909. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that salinity
increase in Gujarat is causing a concern to
agriculture;
(b) if so, how much land ahs been
rendered useless for agriculture due to
salinity ingress i Gujarat during the recent
years;
(c) what steps Government propose and
the time frame to meet the above situation,
to stop salinity ingress; and
(d) the details of saline land of States
and Union Territories having Coastal areas,
from 1991 to 2001?
Non-availability of insecticieds to
farmers
†910. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
farmers at several places in the country are
agitating due to non-availability of
insecticides to them;
(b) if so, at which places;
(c) what measures Government are
taking to make the insecticides available to
farmers; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Red soil disease of coconut
911. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO:
DR. Y. LAKSHMI PRASAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether red soil disease in coconut
plant, has been reported in Andhra Pradesh,
especially in Sritrakulam;
(b) if so, the reasons analysed for the
disease;  and
(c) the action taken to seek opinion of
experts for remedial measureing this regard?
Agricultural reforms
912. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:

Agreement with Philippines for rice
varieties
915. SHRI C.P. THIRUNAVUK-
KARASU: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Council
of Agriculture Research and the International
Rice Research Institute, Philippines, ahve
signed a work plan to produce germ plasm
on upper Rice for higher yield and Golden
rice' with vitamin A; and
(b) if so, what are the sailent conditions
of the agreement?
Agriculture growth in H.P.
916. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) what is the rate of growth targetted
and achieved in agricultural sector in
Himachal Pradesh during the last four years;
(b) the target set for the year 2001-2002
and the likely achievement thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
improve the rate of growth of production in
Himachal Pradesh, especially in hilly areas?
(a) whether the Union Government have
decided to introduce new agriculture
reforms;
(b) if so, whether there is no shortage of
foodgrains in the country at present, and
there is excess stock, which has created
problems for storage;
(c) whether this excess of foodgrains
has necessitated corporate management in
agriculture sector; and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to take to improve the agriculture
sector, to meet the situation of excess
foodgrains in the country?
Slaughtering of cattle
913. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) when was the last census of livestock
carried out in the country and what was the
cattle population as per that census, State-
wise;
(b) how many cattle heads ahve been
slaughtered since 1992, year-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that inspite of
legal and illegal slauthtering, the cattle
population is not depleting; if so, the details
in this regard; and
(d) what steps are taken to prevent illegal
slaughtering of cattle-heads?

Government to purchase cotton from cotton
